title: A Winter for the Well
author: S. M. Nystrom
blurb: Kestrel Quintana, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
